name: Horizontal Integration Facility (HIF)
summary: Climate-controlled SpaceX integration hangar at the base of the pad ramp where Falcon 9 stages and payload fairings are mated horizontally.
function: Houses horizontal mating of Stage 1, Stage 2, and encapsulated payload onto the Transporter/Erector (T/E) before rollout up the pad ramp.
materials: Steel-framed insulated industrial hangar with overhead bridge cranes, ISO-class payload clean zone, and heavy rail rollout track.

specs.label: Hangar Length (approx.)
specs.source: Must accommodate full 70 m Falcon 9 stack

history: Unlike NASA's vertical Vehicle Assembly Building workflow, SpaceX adopted horizontal integration at all three orbital pads to speed turnaround and simplify booster refurbishment.
